newsitem.title: USA: Teco to acquire Lykes Energy.
newsitem.headline: Teco to acquire Lykes Energy.

text.p: Teco Energy Inc. will acquire Lykes Energy Inc., which owns Florida's largest natural gas distribution company, in a stock deal valued at $300 million, the companies said Friday.

Lykes, a closely held company based in Tampa, Fla., owns Peoples Gas System Inc., the state's biggest gas distribution company, Peoples Gas Co., a propane business; and a unit involved in natural gas marketing.

Under the definitive agreement, Teco will issue about 12.1 million common shares for all of Lyke's shares outstanding, based on Thursday's closing price of $24.75 on the New York Stock Exchange. Teco rose 12.5 cents to $52.25 in early trading Friday.
The exact number of Teco shares to be issued will depend on the average market price during a specified period prior to the closing in mid-1997.
The companies expect some cost savings by cutting duplication in overhead and administrative activities, as well as improved operating efficiencies and lower interest costs.

"At the gas company, we already had begun a productivity review and restructuring which could result in changes in job responsibility and possible reductions in the workforce," said John Brabson, Lykes Energy's president.

"That process is intended to allow us to become more competitive and to continue to grow our company. It is not anticipated that the merger itself will lead to any major layoffs or downsizing," Brabson said.
Teco said it expects the deal to initially depress earnings slightly, but sees favourable future growth prospects.
The merger, to be accounted for as a tax-free pooling of interest, has been approved by both companies' boards of directors. It is subject to certain shareholder and regulatory approvals.
Teco said its quarterly dividend of 28 cents a share will not be affected by the transaction.

Teco's principal subsidiary is Tampa Electric, a regulated electric utility serving west central Florida. Other businesses include TECO Transport & Trade, TECO Coal, TECO Coalbed Methane, TECO Gas & Oil, TECO Power Services and TeCom, which is marketing an advanced, interactive energy management and communications system.
